rows.grounds: numeral indicating the eight supernatural powers
compound expressing that attainment of the siddhis constitutes the root Kaula; internal sandhi joins saṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam

items.question: What attainment constitutes the root Kaula teaching, O fair-faced one?
premises: The eight supernatural powers are named as a key attainment.
The attainment of these powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: Therefore, the attainment of the eight siddhis constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact internal analysis of the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
